title: RoutingRules
description: Which pricing technique prices a line (ARCHITECTURE_V2 §2.5). A single versioned document (key "*"): rules are tried top to bottom on the part's product attributes; the first whose `when` fits AND whose target book's own `appliesWhen` fits the line wins. No rule matching = cost plus with the region config. A user's explicit `pricingType` on a line always beats these rules.

when.description: Attribute equality on the part's product attributes, e.g. { "family": "O-Rings" }.

book.description: Id of a price-list (type PRICE_LIST) or catalog-book (type CATALOG_FORMULA) document. Checked against the store when the rules are published.
